content: Eꞌanoꞌo zae mazaonoꞌo sauꞌa niduꞌa, soꞌosoꞌo niduꞌa, zama guhi, ahiahi zu vaze rae sausauzeꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌa nunu mae vaḡinoꞌi.
Ene guraḡaniꞌa viꞌa nune vuḡa urate rudauꞌeteꞌe teige, zae zuni vine moneo nune vuḡa iriga moꞌi. ꞌOugine zaꞌe ḡuhuradu ḡabone hidiꞌuma.
Zaꞌe edeḡa, Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌe manoḡa tauḡi. Eꞌanoꞌo vine moneo nune gagihi rae ufeta inaroꞌi.
Hadi Ḡaboga zu Ohotiroteꞌe Azaḡa
Keriso vaḡe aroꞌi. Aniꞌe vazeꞌa hezahoharo, rehano Badiꞌaꞌa ohotadu ane ubumao Kerisoꞌe ḡihiꞌaḡa rae reiro. Aniꞌe ne duꞌe rinedeꞌeteꞌe hadiḡa heuḡa. Hadi aꞌe ḡaboga zu ḡihiꞌaḡa.

Zae zuni hadi ḡaboga heuḡa. Badiꞌaꞌa zae ohozadu Badiꞌa Vineꞌa radiuꞌeteꞌe neḡa ogoruꞌohe. Ebu zaꞌe dibuꞌo azaḡa zaḡoḡano ohozadu zaeꞌa Iesu Keriso uꞌano vine dibuꞌoḡa Badiꞌa haꞌuma. ꞌOugine, Badiꞌaꞌa matuꞌiꞌuma.
Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae raꞌohe,

content.text: Hadi aꞌe eḡeꞌa ohotiro. Aꞌe, ne duꞌe rinedeꞌeteꞌe hadiḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa hune.

content: Zaꞌe fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ꞌahine, hadi ꞌadiꞌe zae mazaoꞌe ḡihiꞌaḡa. Rehano mene fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mazaoꞌe Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige raꞌohe,

content.text: “Vazeꞌa hadi hina ne ogorarotene, zeꞌa mae modiroteꞌe hadiḡaꞌe

content: Ebu raenaꞌa,

content.text: “Hadi ꞌadiꞌe, vazeꞌa tutuhanadu higau baureꞌeteꞌe hadiḡa,

content: Zeꞌe Badiꞌa ḡoere mene egohauꞌeteꞌe uꞌano tutuhanadu uiteꞌohe. ꞌUguḡaniꞌa zeḡe mazao fureranoga veize Badiꞌaꞌa ze irina ohoziro.

Rehano zaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa ohotiroteꞌe azaḡa, Kini veize gaueꞌeteꞌe dibuꞌoḡa azaḡa, haba ꞌadi azaḡa zaḡoḡa, zu Badiꞌa mone azaḡa. Badiꞌaꞌa zaꞌe uzaboonoꞌo mae vaḡizadu ane agaḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa zamaḡano mae zouziro. ꞌOugadu zaeꞌa ani haḡai manomano rae fureneꞌohe.
Ibite zaꞌe Badiꞌa mone mene azaḡa, rehano izidi zaꞌe ane mone azaḡa. Ibite Badiꞌaꞌa za mene vetuḡaziro, rehano izidi vetuḡaziꞌohe.

Eḡe zamarone azaḡa, zaꞌe raha ꞌadao iꞌudo azaḡa zu avoꞌa azaḡa teigeꞌohe. E za inare ziꞌohe, ahiri urao haḡai sauꞌa haḡaihi rae raꞌeteꞌe zamaroneḡa mae vaḡinoꞌi. Zamarone ꞌuguḡaꞌe vineze agiroziꞌenaꞌa, utitoziꞌohe.

Badiꞌa aḡuꞌa azaḡa boꞌaḡano haḡai manoḡa haḡae radoꞌi. Ze zaeꞌa haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeꞌohe rae sausauziꞌuma, rehano zaꞌa haḡai manoḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe horonadu ze Badiꞌaꞌa emeḡe vaḡe ariteꞌe madaḡano ani ni mae ḡihiniꞌuma.
Vaze Ibitoziꞌeteꞌe Azaḡa Egozenoꞌi
Raha ꞌadao vaze ibitoziꞌeteꞌe inaraḡa meiroteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa egozenoꞌi. Zuhiꞌa Boro veize ꞌouge haḡaoꞌi. Raha kiniḡa egohanoꞌi. Ane inaraꞌe boro hune.
Gavana azaḡa egozenoꞌi. Zeꞌe nagini veꞌoḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa aduga zenoga veize ebu duduḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niguzoga veize kiniꞌa tuḡuziro.
Badiꞌaꞌe zaeꞌa haḡai manoḡa haḡaoga urateꞌohe. Haḡai manoḡa haḡadu kauriḡa azaḡaniꞌa Badiꞌa aḡuꞌa uꞌano veꞌore ḡoereꞌeteꞌe ꞌuiꞌuma.
Zaꞌe mene tuḡure azaḡano radoꞌi. Rehano zaꞌe bohaꞌa radu sauꞌa nunu haḡaeꞌeteꞌe ibiḡano ago radoꞌi, rehano Badiꞌa tuḡure azaḡano radoꞌi.
Vaze niduꞌa faine gubazoꞌi. Ekalesia zamaḡano zae teite tiburu fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa, negoze nabudize zamaroꞌi. Badiꞌa rihonoꞌi zu raha kiniḡa gubanoꞌi.
Zuhiꞌaze Egohanoꞌi zu Keriso Aduga Hegotoꞌi
Tuḡure azaḡa, zaꞌe zuhiꞌaze gubazeꞌenaꞌa, ḡoereze egozenoꞌi. Zae mazao manoreꞌeteꞌe zu vetuḡaziꞌeteꞌe zuhiꞌaze mazao daꞌoꞌe mene, rehano aduga ziniꞌeteꞌe zuhiꞌaze mazao zuni ꞌouge haḡaoꞌi.
Za veꞌoḡa mene haḡairoteꞌe madaḡano zuhiꞌazeꞌa za aduga zinine, Badiꞌa zamareꞌenaꞌa, eꞌe aduga gigiꞌaḡano zamaze obone tiꞌuma. ꞌOugine, Badiꞌaꞌa zae niguziꞌuma.

Zaꞌe gau nu haḡae veꞌoriroteꞌe uꞌano vazeꞌa bouzadu za zamaze obone tine, Badiꞌaꞌa eꞌe moneo zae mene niguziꞌuma. Rehano haḡai manoḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe uꞌano aduga hidadu zamaze obone tine, Badiꞌaꞌa zae niguziꞌuma.
Zaeꞌa ꞌouge haḡaoga veize Badiꞌaꞌa huziro. Mazaḡa Kerisoꞌa zae veize aduga hidadu zaꞌa ane oda iḡuꞌa hegotifine ane aduga ꞌuguḡa zae ihoziro.

content.text: ebu hebeꞌa hina vaze soꞌosoꞌozeꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌa mene reiro.”

content: Vazeꞌa ani rae sausaunirotene, ani ze mene rae sausauziro. Vazeꞌa aduga harotene, ani zeḡe mazao aduga baronoziniꞌuma rae mene reiro. Rehano duduḡa ibiḡano vaze kotazeꞌeteꞌe Badiꞌaḡa ꞌevoreo ze riꞌiziro.

Aniꞌa ane ahiri rana emeḡe haḡai sauꞌa mae teadu satauro rana rudaro. Aꞌe emeḡeꞌa haḡai sauꞌa moneoꞌe rudanadu mene bare haḡaifine ebu haḡai duduḡa haḡae radifine reiro. Vazeꞌa ani ahiꞌa sausauniroteꞌe uꞌano, zaꞌe haḡai sauꞌanonoꞌo manoriro.
Ibite zaꞌe mamoeꞌa doudiroteꞌe teigiro, rehano izidi mamoe taufeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa vaḡe bariro. Aniꞌe zae vine faine ḡianeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa.
